The governed faces are the PM status model, the dispatch-word construction rules and the dev contract; the judgment is whether each sentence says what the card's authority says, and whether each deletion removes nothing the files do not still say. Written 2026-10-14T07:03Z.

### ① Derived judgments

- `SKILL.md` L108, the `pm:blocked` row amended in place: 「正文或线程行首 `Blocked-by:` 指向无 `Ruled:` 的 open `needs-user-decision` 卡 ⇒ ⛔ 不派发,挂本态直至其 `Ruled:`」 — the card's change 1 (a card whose body or thread carries `Blocked-by:` naming an open `needs-user-decision` card is not dispatched and stays `pm:blocked` until that card carries `Ruled:`). Correct, and the row is the status model every seat reads at selection; the line-head form is the canonical marker (`state-machine.md` L24). The card names "SKILL.md 派发 lines and the dispatch reference" as the gate's homes; the gate is written once, in the status row, and the reference carries the measure-first branch (below) — a second copy would be the restatement the ratchet makes a file pay for. Accepted as the single-source form.
- `dispatch-runbook.md` L235 amended 「测量先行卡(修复由测量结果有条件授权)⇒ 只派只读读数 dev 或不派等裁;建设 dev 待裁」 and L236 new 「只读读数 dev 不建闭包、不跑测试、不开 PR;只读树与记录,读数贴决策卡或立卡」 — the card's change 2 (a measure-then-decide dispatch sends a reading-only dev: no build, no test run, no worktree closure; it reads the tree and the record and posts the reading on the decision card or files one; the building dev only after the ruling). Correct; the maintainer's own term 「只读读数」 is used. The old L235 clause 「派发令写明 ⛔ 测量存在之前不写修复」 is subsumed: a dev that may not build or open a PR cannot write the fix before the measurement.
- `os-dev.md` L354 new 「派发词标只读读数 ⇒ 不建闭包、不跑测试、不开 PR;报 `status: "reading"`,读数贴决策卡」 under 〈何时停手不写码〉, and the report enum L364 gains `| reading` — the card's change 3 (the mode's one line; a report with `status: reading`). Correct, and the same term as the runbook.
- Deletions, read against the head: `dispatch-runbook.md` old L206 「内部 PM 副本 = `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 升级与决策 节的四轴框架块」 is folded into the amended L205 「四轴框架块(SKILL.md 升级与决策 节)整段现取现粘、逐单随派发词下发」 — the fact (where the PM's copy lives) survives in the same section; `os-dev.md` old L354 「升级分析的四轴决策框架由派发词携带,PM 从自己那份副本填入」 is restated by the surviving L355 「框架唯一副本在 pm-dispatch SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉;派发词逐字粘贴,dev ⛔ 不留副本」 and L356 (stop and ask the PM when the dispatch did not carry it). Nothing a seat or a dev still owes leaves either file; `check:skill-frame-sync` green on the head.
- Boundary with PR #23405 (the first 串行接力 leg): this head edits `os-dev.md` L354 and L364, `dispatch-runbook.md` L205–206 and L235–236, `SKILL.md` L108 — none of #23405's hunks (`os-dev.md` L138, L140–141, L143, L147–148, L158–163, the inserts after L245 and L278, L370; `dispatch-runbook.md` L220; `AGENTS.md` L584–585); the dev's `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head against `63496bd46c` returned no conflict (a read, nothing merged); `AGENTS.md` untouched. The three files are byte-identical between `e4ec6ec1a5` and `5656c5638a`, so the dispatch's line numbers held.
- Ratchet on the head: `SKILL.md` 319/319 (its widest table row stays at the 342-byte pin; the amended row is 295 bytes, and table rows are the exempt class of `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`), `dispatch-runbook.md` 241/241, `os-dev.md` 402/402 — every added line paid by a same-file deletion named above; no ceiling moved; every non-table line edited is under 120 bytes; the four-axis block L241–261 (md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0`) and the 速读 lines are untouched. `Lint & Repo Gates` (the ratchet, the id lint, the governed-prose scan, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:agent-model-declared`) `success` on the head. `Fixes #23379` is the body's only closing keyword (#23224, #23266, #23267, #23378, #23381, #23405 carry no closing verb); `Clause-②: no` is correct — internal protocol text, no published surface.
- The card's acceptance item "a dry run on #23267's claim text shows the gate refusing the building dispatch", as the PR body reads it against the record: the `Blocked-by:` leg does not fire at the claim's instant (the body's only line-head marker is `Blocked-by: #23224`, never a decision card; #23266 is named in a prose heading and had been ruled C hours earlier with its label removed), the measure-then-decide leg does refuse it (the claim's file surface makes the dev's first act a measurement that selects the route; the dev returned `needs_decision` and the ruling followed). One leg refuses; the card's premise about the other leg is corrected in the body, not forced. Accepted as the honest reading.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag — the derived gate set was 22 families, not the six the dispatch named; all 22 ran and reconciled (`--ran`: 22/22). The dispatch's list was a mechanism assumption; the derivation is the rule. Accepted.
- Dev flag — one targeted build ran locally (two packages under the verify lock) because `check:doc-formula-expressions` answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET on an unbuilt tree; the gate then exited 0 and the tree stayed clean. The dispatch's "no build" was a text-only assumption, not a prohibition; a prerequisite build for a derived gate is the dev contract's own rule. Accepted.
- Observation (dev, no card): #23266's ruling is a `## Ruling` comment without a `Ruled:` first line (pre-convention); the gate reads `Ruled:` together with the label and the open state, so a ruled card whose label was stripped does not trip it. No open card affected.
